## Feature details

### F1 · Join with team code
- **Behaviour:** `/play` asks for name (2–40 chars) and team code. The `player-join` Edge Function creates the account and signs the phone in. The 4th member locks the team.
- **Acceptance:** a wrong code, a full team or a locked team is refused with a clear message; a joined player reopening the link lands on their status screen; the admin sees the member appear within 2 s.
- **Edge cases:** same name twice in one team → refused. A member joining again on a new phone with the same name + code moves their session (old phone logged out) and alerts the admin. Registration closed → refused.

### F2 · Team lobby & live status
- **Behaviour:** shows teammates with a tick for each member's progress, the round, the phase, and broadcasts.
- **Acceptance:** status changes within 1 s of any teammate's action; reconnect resyncs.

### F3 · QR scanner + key check-in
- **Behaviour:** camera scanner in `/play`. The scan is resolved on the server (see [SYSTEM_WORKFLOW.md](SYSTEM_WORKFLOW.md#scan-resolution)). At the team's own QR, the member then types the 6-character key.
- **Acceptance:** the round completes only when all 4 active members have scanned **and** typed the right key; the team sees "3/4 checked in". A QR from a later round shows the **Sealed mark** screen ("this mark belongs to a later round") with no clue and no key box; a key sent for it anyway is refused (D-025). At the final QR each member also types the crew's seal code (D-026).
- **Edge cases:** wrong key (rate-limited, alert after 5); scanning in a normal camera app opens `/q/<token>`, which has no side effects and asks to open the game.

### F4 · Member questions & clue pieces
- **Behaviour:** each member gets a random unseen question for the round's difficulty, with its format note ("one word", "a number", "A/B/C/D"). A correct answer unlocks one clue piece for the whole team.
- **Acceptance:** typed answers matched case-, accent- and space-insensitively against the answer plus alternatives; multiple choice has exactly 4 options shuffled per player, and a wrong pick swaps in an unseen question with no hint ever (D-029); every 3rd wrong answer, multiple choice or typed, adds 1 minute to the crew's penalty and nobody is locked out (D-041); the answer is never sent to the client; no question repeats within a team.

### F5 · Treasure map
- **Behaviour:** the venue map in parchment style. Fog covers everything; it lifts over the target region when all pieces are unlocked; visited places stay revealed.
- **Acceptance:** the region (not the exact pin) is revealed; the map is usable one-handed and loads in under 2 s on 4G.

### F6 · Prank QRs
- **Behaviour:** see [PRD](PRD.md#game-rules-source-of-truth). Any team can scan them at any time.
- **Acceptance:** the fake key is clearly not a real completion key; the admin feed logs "Team 3 fell for a prank".

### F7 · Hints with penalty
- **Behaviour:** admin one-click toggle. A member taps **Hint** on their question → confirm "+1 minute" → hint shown. Penalty is served at the next check-in as a countdown.
- **Acceptance:** penalty total visible to the team; completion time = check-in time + penalty.

### F8 · Rounds, elimination & finish
- **Behaviour:** see the PRD rules. Round close and elimination run inside the check-in transaction.
- **Acceptance:** exactly X teams complete each round; the eliminated set is exactly the others; podium = first 3 final completions; completion keys unique per team.

### F9 · Anti-cheat warnings
- **Behaviour:** while a question is open, `visibilitychange`/`blur`/`pagehide` shows the player a warning on return and sends an alert.
- **Acceptance:** the alert reaches the admin within 2 s; capped at 50 per question.

### F10 · One-click game generator
- **Behaviour:** inputs: teams (from registered), locations, optional overrides (QR counts, X defaults, prank %). **Generate** builds the pyramid, links, team paths, prank set, question picks and all secrets, then validates it.
- **Acceptance:** fails with a clear message if there are fewer locations than QRs; every team has a path to the final; no dead ends; re-generate allowed until Start.

### F11 · Locations & map editor
- **Behaviour:** upload the venue map image, add locations (name, notes, 4 clue pieces, hint), drag pins, set a reveal radius.
- **Acceptance:** locations persist across games.

### F12 · Printable QR sheet
- **Behaviour:** print view, 2 QRs per A4. The hidden card shows only the QR and its key (identical for every kind, D-031); a cut-off placement stub carries the label, round, location name and "hide it here" note. Pranks and the universal QR included. Separate "admin master list" and crew code slips.
- **Acceptance:** every QR in the game appears exactly once; print preview correct in Chrome.

### F13 · Admin live dashboard
- **Behaviour:** timeline ("Team 4 · Ana scanned R2-07 · Library"), a progress row per team (round, phase, 4 member ticks, penalty), alerts rail (wrong-team, future-round, prank, key spam, left site, stuck > 10 min).
- **Acceptance:** updates within 2 s; alerts can be acknowledged.

### F14 · Game controls
- Start · Pause/Resume (blocks every player action) · Broadcast (message on every phone) · Hints on/off · Set X for any open or future round · End game.

### F15 · Override toolkit
- Move a team forward/back a round · Mark a member inactive (team continues with 3; pieces merge) · Re-point a team to a spare QR · Kick a player · Disqualify a team. Each needs a reason and is audited.

### F16 · Audit log & export
- Insert-only log of admin actions and alerts. CSV export of teams, members, round times, ranks and the log.

### F17 · New game
- See PRD. Typed confirmation `NEW GAME`.

### F18 · Question bank
- Manual add/edit/disable, CSV import with a per-row report. Seed: hand-written questions across coding, memes, funny, GK, history, geography, difficulty 1–5.

### F19 · Leaderboard & eliminated view
- Optional panel in `/play`. Eliminated teams choose Game Over or Spectator.

### F20 · Projector screen
- `/screen`: live leaderboard with smooth reorder animations; parchment map with a ship per team; round-closed and elimination splashes; the universal QR at start; the realistic 3D treasure-chest opening and podium at the end.

### F21 · Bot simulation
- `npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/simulate.ts --teams 10 --runs 5`. Bots join, scan, answer (some wrong), use hints, hit pranks and wrong-team QRs; every rule checked each step; report in `docs/reports/simulation.md`. Refuses to run against production.

### F22 · Admin login
- `/admin/login`: admin name + passcode.
